detail.longDescription: Small one for anyone running an MCP server on their own machine over HTTP: Bind it to 127.0.0.1, not 0.0.0.0, and validate the Origin header (the spec says return 403 if it's present and invalid). The MCP transport spec gives the reason: without these, a website you happen to visit can talk to your local server through DNS rebinding. # MCP # AIagents # AppSec # infosec # devtools # ClaudeCode # Cursor # localhost # DNS # webdev
